dedupe_keys.name: national land numerical information power generation facilities 発電施設 p03 japan

description: This National Land Numerical Information data set from Japan's Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism gives points for power generation facilities across Japan: hydro, pumped storage, thermal, geothermal, nuclear, wind, solar, biomass and combined facilities. Attributes include operator, facility name, address, existing or under construction status, start of operation, authorised output, and RPS law or green power certification dates and capacities, with extra fields such as river system and scheme type for hydro and maximum water use for pumped storage. The latest edition is fiscal 2013, with earlier 2007 and 1995 editions. It was compiled from the power development overview, the electricity business handbook, RPS and green power certification lists and internet sources, geocoded from addresses, and stored as GML and one shapefile per generation type in JGD2000 geographic coordinates. Coverage is Japan. Downloads are free, but the terms of use on the page are non-commercial. Caveats: the data have not been updated since 2013, the general hydro layer lists only plants of 50 MW and above, and the Electrical Japan site notes that large feed-in tariff solar plants and mid-sized hydro are missing. Simulation uses are generation asset locations for hazard exposure and historical capacity studies. Related records: data-electrical-japan-power-plant-database is an independently compiled alternative.
